system.description: A pillar of pure photonic light spears a foe within 100'. It leaves a scorched glyph on the ground that sheds light 30' for an hour.

outcomes.success: The foe takes 2d10 damage. It and every creature adjacent to it are Blinded until the end of their next turn.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and no one is Blinded.
outcomes.ruin: The light comes down on you: you are Blinded until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
